input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Despite the Section 7 heading referring to "INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR", the Agreement contains no operative indemnity language anywhere: Section 7 has only liability caps, a consequential-damages waiver and an attorneys'-fees waiver, and searches for indemnify / hold harmless / defend / third-party claim return nothing further. Section 5(c)'s non-infringement warranty does not fund the defence or damages of a third-party IP claim. Absence of any Vendor IP indemnity is walk-away territory, so we inserted our fallback position as new Section 7(d): a Contractor third-party IP indemnity with the customary Company-modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace remedies with a refund of fees paid if none is commercially available, and a super-cap of three times annual fees expressed to override the Section 7(a) fees-paid cap so the indemnity is not swallowed by it. No Company indemnity exists, so nothing required narrowing; preferred-level items (defence of affiliates, breach of law, data breach, misconduct, claim procedure) were not pursued at this fallback target.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from Company's modification of the Services or Works, from combination of the Services or Works with items not supplied by Contractor, or from Company's written specifications. For any such claim, Contractor shall procure for Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is commercially available, Contractor shall refund the fees paid for the affected item. Notwithstanding Paragraph 7(a), Contractor's aggregate liability under this Paragraph 7(d) shall not exceed three times (3x) the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.
